scope: Local Node fetch cancellation mechanism and thin browser proxy guard
interpretation: Abort after reading a complete cloned response can make the original async body iterator finish silently with zero bytes. The proxy must inspect the combined signal as well as body length before sending success.
change: Retain combined disconnect/deadline signal and throwIfAborted after finite JSON body iteration, before writing response headers.
causalLimit: Matches observed body-loss mechanism but does not establish which signal caused the packaged browser failure. No rendered acceptance or installation claim.

gate.scope: Complete isolated Node adapter/controller suites; fixtures are synthetic, not native inference, live browser or rendered IDE acceptance
